methods.label: Similarity preserves the sine ratio
methods.explanation: The enlarged triangle is similar to the original triangle. Angle \(A\) remains unchanged, and the ratio of the opposite side to the hypotenuse remains unchanged, so \(\sin A\) remains unchanged. The value of a trigonometric function depends only on the size of the angle.
